column3: in the Lord of high and low
went with minds devoted to austerity
went from there to the hermitage of Nara-Narayana
of yama, niyama and so on
by those whose selves are Lava (?)
in the form of a mare
approached the foot of the Vindhya
I reason about the brahmana's sons
to be thought of by lords
heroes, by as many at once
having cast off on both sides the inner self
O brahmana, to you by daughters
by causes of discrimination of Brahman
removing fear of those who take refuge
with cool water from the eyes
one should contemplate the unbearable splendour of ten-hundred-spoked (discus)
one should contemplate the Lord's lotus feet
crowded with aerial cars shaken by manes
stories of the Lord for the good
in Sati's giving up the body
with arches, streets and squares sprinkled
kinsman of the good, the blind-eyed
of the real, the non-differentiated eater
in the nectar of good ears
of those whose body is sattva, of men
treasure of sattva, wishing to do
awakening those made of sattva, rajas, tamas
awakening those made of sattva, rajas, tamas (garbled)
of those with sattva, rajas, tamas
heart made of sattva, rajas, tamas within
by stains of sattva, rajas, tamas
by stains of sattva, rajas, tamas, of the mind of ego
joined with sattva, to be inferred by calm and others
bull among those of pure being
the First Person in sattva and others
by sattva like a mountain king
any one of the two by sattva
forms of truth, knowledge, infinity, bliss, one rasa only
truth, red with sun's rays, Uttara's jaw
speaking truth, initiation of the Self
remainder of the sacrifice of the Self
sang in the sacrifice of the Prachetas
from company of the good, free of bad company
in the assembly of the good
of the company of the good
to be served by the good
transgression against the good, dear to the noble
of the proud of being real
those who know the Self touch all this as the Self
with compassionate glances, the gopis within
sin of non-observance of the good
as the nature of real and unreal
of the nature of real and unreal
of the nature of real and unreal (object)
Lord of the real and unreal
to the lords of the assembly (Hindi)
sitting in the assembly with his eye
having passed lords of the assembly
always bathed, sleeping on the ground, avadhuta
appearance of the real in this unreal
appearance of the real in this unreal
ornament of the immortal world always
of the wives, hearts carried off by eagerness
with wife went to the forest of austerity
you were always of sesame, silver beds
as if from the Self's ill state
by the play of origin, position and dissolution of the real
of the particulars of reality, many yet one unjoined
with smoke, fire, made of austerity
heart burned by grief for kinsmen's killing
being, the Self situated in the Self
the sage would not be content with senses' pleasures
to abandon the thought of Uttamashloka
of men at the two twilights
with splendour like twilight cloud army
by rivals, those dragged by the hair in the unfair dice game
of those whose fortune rivals stole
with leaves spoken by the co-wife (garbled)
at once all sins cast off
at once manifest, the highest Self seen
the three worlds with guardians, fearless of death, proud
seven times he circled the sun
seventeen times, akshauhinis of that size
cosmic egg with seven ten-fold greater layers
though knowledge gained from the seventh month
on the seventh day from today onward, subduer of foes
at the end of seven nights
seven rivers on the chest of the far-stepper
seven houses not arranged, should be content with what is gained
for a week with one hand
at the end of a week
seven bulls of great strength, valour, with very sharp horns
seven oxen, Shambara, Vidurathas, Rukmi and chiefs
with the Pranava and the three-footed Gayatri
the gods thought it wonder with breath
the sound of loved ones was tumultuous
with loving laughter, rasa, glances, sweet talk
with fearful eyes, those looking at the glorious face, meanings explained
with halls, squares, streets, play-houses, shops
